title: Stop an active recording before destroying it
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[vtc] Stop an active recording before destroying it
Spec (3cbb0c4): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L1162: "`destroy` removes the VTCRecording metadata. If the recording is in state `\"recording\"` or `\"paused\"`, the server first stops it and delivers the `VTCRecordingStateEvent` with `state: \"stopped\"`."
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/media.rs:924-939
Now: destroy_media fetches the object, checks the moderator and destroys it. A recording or paused VTCRecording is removed with no stop and no consent event.
Change: For Kind::Recording with state recording or paused, apply the stop patch (state stopped, stoppedAt) and deliver a VTCRecordingStateEvent with state stopped before destroy_object.
